arxiv-2312-15772.description: Abstract . We present a general procedure to construct examples of convex scalar variational problems which admit a minimizers with large singular sets. The dimension of the set of singularities is maximal and the minimizer has no higher integrability property (failure of Meyers property). 2000 Mathematics Subject Classification 35R11; 47G20; 46E35 Dedicated to Nina Nikolaevna Uraltseva 1.

arxiv-2402-08491.title: pbn-STAC: Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Framework for Cellular Reprogramming
arxiv-2402-08491.creator: Andrzej Mizera, Jakub Zarzycki
arxiv-2402-08491.description: Abstract Cellular reprogramming can be used for both the prevention and cure of complex diseases. However, the efficiency of discovering reprogramming strategies with classical wet-lab experiments is hindered by lengthy time commitments and high costs. In this study, we leverage deep reinforcement learning to develop a novel computational framework that facilitates the identification of reprogramming strategies.

arxiv-2406-04712.title: AICoderEval: Improving AI Domain Code Generation of Large Language Models
arxiv-2406-04712.creator: Yinghui Xia, Yuyan Chen, Tianyu Shi, Jun Wang, Jinsong Yang
arxiv-2406-04712.description: Abstract Automated code generation is a pivotal capability of large language models (LLMs). However, assessing this capability in real-world scenarios remains challenging. Previous methods focus more on low-level code generation, such as model loading, instead of generating high-level codes catering for real-world tasks, such as image-to-text, text classification, in various domains.

arxiv-2509-03632.title: A One-Particle Density Matrix Framework for Mode-Shell Correspondence: Characterizing Topology in Higher-Order Topological Insulators
arxiv-2509-03632.creator: Miguel F. Martínez, Lucien Jezequel, Jens H. Bardarson, Thomas Klein Kvorning, Julia D. Hannukainen
arxiv-2509-03632.description: Abstract We present a framework for characterizing higher-order topological phases directly from the one-particle density matrix, without any reference to an underlying Hamiltonian. Our approach extends the mode–shell correspondence, originally formulated for single-particle Hamiltonians, to Gaussian states subject to chiral constraints.

arxiv-2509-07791.title: Prime One-Sided Ideals in Principal Ideal Domains
arxiv-2509-07791.creator: Masood Aryapoor
arxiv-2509-07791.description: Abstract This article investigates various notions of primeness for one-sided ideals in noncommutative rings, with a focus on principal ideal domains. 1 Introduction The concept of primeness in ring theory has long served as a cornerstone for understanding the structural properties of rings and their ideals.

arxiv-2602-16623.title: Beyond the Classical Ceiling: Multi-Layer Fully-Connected Variational Quantum Circuits
arxiv-2602-16623.creator: Howard Su, Chen-Yu Liu, Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Kuan-Cheng Chen, Huan-Hsin Tseng
arxiv-2602-16623.description: Abstract Standard Variational Quantum Circuits (VQCs) struggle to scale to high-dimensional data due to the “curse of dimensionality,” which manifests as exponential simulation costs ( 𝒪 ⁡ ( 2 d ) \mathcal{O}(2^{d}) ) and untrainable Barren Plateaus. Existing solutions often bypass this by relying on classical neural networks for feature compression, obscuring the true quantum capability.

pmc-10603289.creator: Priya Arora, James M Elliott, Fereshteh Pourkazemi, Roxanna Nasseri Pebdani
pmc-10603289.description: Key Clinical MessageReconceptualising acute Musculoskeletal (MSK) injuries with both stress‐ and tissue‐ based factors is required to consider prior influences of mental health disorders on acute persistent MSK pain presentations. This report describes repeated emergency presentations of an individual with acute persistent MSK pain in their twenties living with mental health.

pmc-11671991.title: The good, the bad and the ugly: What do we really do when we identify the best and the worst organisations?
pmc-11671991.creator: Gary A Abel, Denis Agniel, Marc N Elliott
pmc-11671991.description: Identifying high and poorly performing organisations is common practice in healthcare. Often this is done within a frequentist inferential framework where statistical techniques are used that acknowledge that observed performance is an imperfect measure of underlying quality. Various methods are employed for this purpose, but the influence of chance on the degree of misclassification is often underappreciated.

pmc-12557193.title: Using Rogers’ innovation attributes in ECAC-4 implementation: psychometric evaluation
pmc-12557193.creator: L Roxo, AJ Santos, M Sousa-Uva
pmc-12557193.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundThe 4th European Code Against Cancer (ECAC-4) outlines recommendations to reduce individual cancer risk. pmc-12989495.title: Children’s rights and needs during war: the case of adolescents in Israel
pmc-12989495.creator: Yonat Rum, Erez Milsthen, Heba F. Zedan, Tali Gal
pmc-12989495.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). IntroductionThis study aims to examine the attainment of rights and needs of adolescents during the war following the October 7th 2023 terror attack on Israel. A normative analysis of the human rights of children and youth, based on the United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child (CRC), was integrated with an empirical examination of children’s rights and needs attainment. Committed to a children’s rights epistemology, the empirical examination is based on children’s own reports.

pmc-13232398.description: ObjectivesThis study aimed to analyze the epidemiological characteristics of Enterohemorrhagic Escherichia coli (EHEC) infections in Republic of Korea from 2019 to 2024 based on surveillance and epidemiological investigation data, providing a scientific basis for establishing effective prevention and control strategies.MethodsWe analyzed the incidence trends, age distribution, geographic regions, dietary risk factors, complications, and serotypes of EHEC infections.

pmc-13252037.title: The Gut-Brain Axis in Comorbidity of Inflammatory Bowel Disease and Anxiety/Depression: Mechanisms, Controversies, and Future Directions
pmc-13252037.creator: Yuheng Cui, Yangfeng Huang
pmc-13252037.description: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), including Crohn’s disease (CD), ulcerative colitis (UC), and IBD unclassified (IBD-U), frequently cooccurs with anxiety and depression, a comorbid pattern that severely impairs patients’ quality of life and has thus attracted increasing attention in clinical practice.

pmc-13366675.description: al decline, but patient engagement remains suboptimal. While in-bed cycling improves physical outcomes, integrating immersive virtual reality (VR) might enhance motivation. pmc-13583654.title: High rate of Healthcare Associated Infections in a Nigerian Tertiary Hospital: A Point Prevalence Survey Highlighting Neonatal and Paediatric Vulnerability
pmc-13583654.creator: M Z Sabitu, Y Mohammed, O O Oduyebo, T Yusuf, I N Nwafia, I W Isa Musa, BG Aljannare, J Abubakar, Y Saminu, K M Dada, H Mathew, U Faruk, A Versporten
pmc-13583654.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background:Healthcare-associated infections (HAIs) are a major patient safety threat globally, with high burdens in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). In Nigeria, data on HAIs are limited, affecting effective infection prevention and control (IPC) strategies. This study evaluated the prevalence, types, and risk factors of HAIs at Usmanu Danfodiyo University Teaching Hospital (UDUTH) using the Global Point Prevalence Survey (GPPS) HAIs section.Methodology:A cross-sectional point prevalence survey was conducted from 21–25 October 2024 across all inpatient wards using standardised GPPS protocols.

pmc-13658332.description: On April 18th, 2015, a boat carrying about 1,000 migrants sank in the Strait of Sicily, prompting one of the most complex recovery missions ever conducted in the Mediterranean. Operation Melilli was the first time a European Government authorized the recovery of a sunken migrant ship to identify all victims.
